episodes.title: The Important Stuff
episodes.summary: Facing the abrupt end of her marriage, Leanne leans on her sister Carol, concocts cover stories and confronts the prospect of starting over in her 50s.

episodes.title: The Healing Magic of Family
episodes.summary: When Mama Margaret suffers a health scare, Leanne scrambles to keep the family from upsetting her by spilling the beans about Bill.

episodes.title: Oh, Knoxville
episodes.summary: It's ladies' night as Carol whisks Leanne out of her comfort zone and into a local hotspot for a crash course in confidence.

episodes.title: Smooth Like a Dolphin
episodes.summary: With a lawyer in one ear and Carol in the other, Leanne considers a fresh look and a new ride. An unwanted guest threatens to spoil game day.

episodes.title: A Plumber Sent from Heaven
episodes.summary: Leanne sets out to get fit, but temptation is hard to shake — especially after discovering that Carol has a midnight snack of her own.

episodes.title: Too Much Wedding Ring
episodes.summary: A visit from a charismatic law enforcement officer sets off sirens for Leanne. Daddy John finds a gender reveal party to be anything but a piece of cake.

episodes.title: Please Be a Lizard
episodes.summary: Leanne's routine gyno exam gets shaken up by a surprise encounter in the waiting room. Carol and Bill mellow out after sampling some enhanced goodies.

episodes.title: Muscle Memory
episodes.summary: Leanne gets hot and bothered — but not in the way she'd hoped. Carol and Tyler join their elders for an unexpectedly lively night at the movies.

episodes.title: Chipmunk in the Drywall
episodes.summary: A stack of treasured heirlooms resurfaces old sibling tensions. To keep an embarrassing truth under wraps, Mary agrees to mop up Carol's mess.

episodes.title: Apology
episodes.summary: Concerned that Andrew's poker face might be masking something deeper, a suspicious Leanne ropes Carol into an undercover investigation.

episodes.title: Dog Day Afternoon
episodes.summary: As Leanne readies for an exciting step forward, Carol looks back — and realizes her love life could use some serious quality control.

episodes.title: The Queen's Dilemma
episodes.summary: When Leanne's off-the-cuff speech at a local book club is caught on video, her empowering words turn out to be more powerful than anyone expected.

episodes.title: Don't Dangle a Dream
episodes.summary: Leanne vows to fulfill Mama Margaret's decades-old dream of a perfect wedding day. But when her rushed plans go off the rails, she'll have to improvise.

episodes.title: Gomez Is a Woman
episodes.summary: When a long-distance farewell hits close to home, Leanne finds herself rattled by a surprise introduction that stirs up insecurities — and jealousy.

episodes.title: Spiritual Airbags
episodes.summary: After a brush with fate, Leanne decides to tie up loose ends, Carol experiments with her softer side and Sunday service gets an unexpected reboot.

episodes.title: Having Big Feelings
episodes.summary: Whisked away for a surprise weekend of sun and sand, Leanne faces her first big relationship test. But an even bigger surprise awaits back at home.

episodes.title: The Big Hm-Hm
episodes.summary: On the eve of her birthday, Leanne must step in to help Mama Margaret and Daddy John after their forgetfulness leads to an alarming mishap at home.

episodes.title: A Prison of Love
episodes.summary: Leanne struggles to set boundaries as Mama Margaret and Daddy John begrudgingly stay at her house. A spilled secret throws Bill's life into chaos.

episodes.title: The Old Cat Had Her Reasons
episodes.summary: As her relationship takes a surprising turn, Leanne questions her own desires — and the women at her book club chime in with conflicting advice.

episodes.title: Fit as a Fiddle
episodes.summary: A trip to the doctor forces Leanne and Daddy John to have an overdue chat about the future — and helps Carol and Mama Margaret bond like never before.

episodes.title: Big Hammer Energy
episodes.summary: While Bill helps remodel her parents' kitchen, Leanne wrestles with her feelings. A garden project digs up trouble between Carol and Mama Margaret.

episodes.title: An Enhancement...or Two
episodes.summary: After an awkward encounter, Leanne and Carol hit the road with Mary to recapture some of their youthful glow. Daddy John deals Bill in on poker night.

episodes.title: Pickles Are Forever
episodes.summary: Daddy John and Leanne butt heads during a visit to the estate lawyer. After exceeding expectations, Bill makes a case to continue remodeling the house.

episodes.title: Have a Rocky Top Day
episodes.summary: An unexpected guest visits Leanne, raising questions about love and second chances. Mama Margaret arranges a date for Carol with an eligible stranger.

episodes.title: Three Degrees of Southern Women
episodes.summary: At long last, Leanne starts speaking her mind — much to Mama Margaret's dismay. Bill tries to help Daddy John tune up his driving knowledge.

episodes.title: Bang Me
episodes.summary: As Leanne reaches the one-year mark of her separation, a heart-to-heart with her stylist helps reframe her perspective on the past and present.
